unit: A source-located temporal composition or inspectable animation template. Repeated occurrences share a form family; numeric variations are not distinct forms.
rules: No visual claims by a text-only model. Flash processes existing textual annotations only.
4 fps contact sheets screen intervals; rapid glitch/impacts need source-frame-rate inspection.
A repeated chorus occurrence is an observation, not an automatically distinct form.
Do not infer lyrics, emotional intent, AE implementation, licensing or musical synchronization from still frames alone.
Source and template discoveries do not satisfy the investigation count.
Every visual annotation identifies model, actual viewed frames and timestamp interval.
Retain rejected and uncertain observations; no deletion to inflate acceptance.
Synthesis must distinguish observed design from proposed reusable implementation.
status: Protocol only; no completed analysis implied
